fields.label: Journey to Jannah is a four-level Islamic Studies book series created
fields.default: Journey to Jannah is a four-level Islamic Studies book series created for children, progressing through different learning levels. The goal was to make Islamic education more engaging and visually accessible while maintaining a consistent identity throughout the series. I handled the complete design — from covers and layouts to interior pages, illustrations, and character development.

fields.label: Designing for children requires a careful balance: the books needed to
fields.default: Designing for children requires a careful balance: the books needed to communicate educational content clearly without becoming visually boring or overwhelming. Another major challenge was developing the illustration direction, creating the recurring character, and establishing a page layout that could work consistently across a multi-level series.

fields.label: Make learning visually engaging without compromising clarity.
fields.default: Make learning visually engaging without compromising clarity.

fields.label: Colors, typography, illustrations, and visual storytelling were select
fields.default: Colors, typography, illustrations, and visual storytelling were selected specifically to attract children and keep them engaged with the content.

fields.label: A recurring illustrated character was developed as part of the series.
fields.default: A recurring illustrated character was developed as part of the series. The character visually explains different concepts and gives the books a recognizable personality — maintained across all four levels to strengthen consistency. Its clothing colors were adapted across the different books, allowing each level its own variation while remaining clearly connected to the series.

fields.label: Instead of completely redesigning every level, the core visual system
fields.default: Instead of completely redesigning every level, the core visual system remained consistent. Layouts stayed structured and spacious, while selected elements — colors, illustrations, character clothing — were adjusted between levels, creating enough variation to distinguish each publication while keeping the series visually connected.

fields.label: The final outcome was a complete four-level book series, with covers,
fields.default: The final outcome was a complete four-level book series, with covers, interior pages, layouts, illustrations, and a consistent visual system. The client responded very positively after seeing the completed publications.

fields.default: The Path to the Arabic Language is an educational publication project developed for The Quran Scholars Hub

fields.label: s international audience, including two publications: Arabic Conversat
fields.default: s international audience, including two publications: Arabic Conversations , a practical book built around everyday dialogue, and Arabic Grammar , a structured publication covering foundational through advanced concepts.

fields.label: Unlike Journey to Jannah, these publications were designed for relativ
fields.default: Unlike Journey to Jannah, these publications were designed for relatively older learners. The approach was intentionally minimal, professional, and easy to read — focused on typography, structure, readability, consistency, and color rather than unnecessary visual complexity.

fields.label: The original Quran Scholars Hub brand colors were integrated into the
fields.default: The original Quran Scholars Hub brand colors were integrated into the publications, maintaining visual consistency with the wider institution while giving the books a professional and attractive appearance.

fields.label: Typography was kept deliberately minimal, making the information easy
fields.default: Typography was kept deliberately minimal, making the information easy to read and understand without distracting visual elements. For the Conversations publication in particular, the design let the dialogue and educational content remain the primary visual focus.

fields.label: One of the most demanding aspects of the project was working with Arab
fields.default: One of the most demanding aspects of the project was working with Arabic text — careful attention to letterforms, spacing, harakat, i

fields.label: raab, text fitting, and readability. Organizing Arabic content within
fields.default: raab, text fitting, and readability. Organizing Arabic content within fixed design spaces while maintaining accuracy and readability became a key part of the process.

fields.label: The final publications provided a clean, structured, and consistent vi
fields.default: The final publications provided a clean, structured, and consistent visual system for Arabic learning. The client responded very positively and highly appreciated the finished work.
